integrity: The proof is unrestricted. It uses the exact Euler-product identity for \(\varphi(n)\sigma(n)/n^2\), monotonicity when additional prime-power blocks are present, and an exhaustive prime-power enumeration below the threshold. The finite checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the fibers only through the sharp mixed-support threshold \(12\). It does not classify larger fibers or their distribution.
title: Prime-power isolation below the sharp \(12\)-barrier for \(n^2-\varphi(n)\sigma(n)\)
